chapterInfo.content:
3
Hiob abooboodie
1Yei akyiri no, Hiob buee n’ano na ɔdomee n’awoda. 2Na Hiob kaa sɛ:
3 # Yer 20.14-18 Ma ɛda a wɔwoo me mu no nyera,
ne anadwo a ɛse:
Wɔanyinsɛn ɔbabanin no.
4Ɛda no nnuru sum,
mma Onyankopɔn mmfiri soro mmmisa akyiri kwan,
na hann biara nnhyerɛn so.
5Esum ne sunsum nnye no,
mununkum ntena so,
deɛ ɛma adekyeeɛ duru sum nyi no hu.
6Anadwo no, esum kabii nkuta no,
wɔmmma no nnnya anigyeɛ biara afe nna no mu,
wɔmmma no mmma abosome dodoɔ no mu.
7Hwɛ, anadwo no nyɛ kwawee,
ahurisie dwom biara mma mu.
8Ma wɔn a wɔdome da no mmɔ no dua,
wɔn a wɔtumi hwanyan dɛnkyɛmmirampɔn mpo no.
9N’ahemadakye nsoromma bɛduru sum,
ɛbɛtwɛn hann, na ebi remma,
na ɛrenhunu adekyeeɛ anisuatɛtɛ.
10Ɛfiri sɛ anto m’awoɔ apono mu,
na anyi ɔhaw anhunta m’ani.
11Adɛn nti na manwu yafunu mu,
na mannyaa mu, awoeɛ?
12Adɛn nti na anankoroma sɔɔ me,
na adɛn nti na metoo nufoɔ menumiiɛ?
13Anka sɛsɛɛ meda hɔ mayɛ komm,
anka mada, ɛno deɛ anka manya ahomegyeɛ,
14me ne ahemfo ne asase so afotufoɔ
a wɔkyekyeree amamfo faeɛ no,
15anaasɛ me ne mmapɔmma a wɔwɔ sika,
wɔn a wɔde dwetɛ hyehyɛɛ wɔn afie amaama no.
16Anaasɛ menni hɔ sɛ ɛpɔn ba a wɔakora no,
anaa nkɔkoaa a wɔanhunu hann da.
17Ɛhɔ na abɔnefoɔ nha obiara bio,
na abrɛfoɔ gye wɔn ahome.
18Ɛhɔ ara na nneduafoɔ te dwoodwoo,
wɔnte apiafoɔ nne.
19Ɛhɔ na onipa ketewa ne onipa kɛseɛ wɔ,
na akoa afiri ne wura nsa.
20Adɛn nti na ɔma mmɔborɔni hann,
na ɔde nkwa ma wɔn a wɔn kra werɛ ahoɔ,
21 # Adi 9.6 wɔn a wɔtwɛn owuo, na ɛmma,
na wɔbɔre hwehwɛ no sene akoradeɛ,
22wɔn a wɔn ani gye mmorosoɔ,
na wɔn ho sɛpɛ wɔn sɛ anka wɔbɛnya damena,
23 # Hiob 19.8 ne ɔbarima a wɔde ne kwan ahunta,
na Onyankopɔn de ban atwa ne ho ahyia?
24Na m’apinisie abɛsi m’aduane ananmu,
na mesu gu sɛ nsuo.
25Na deɛ mesuro no, ɛno ara na ɛto me,
na deɛ m’akoma tutu ho no, ɛba me so.
26Mennya ahodwoɔ ne kommyɛ ne ɔhome,
na ahodwan ara na ɛba.

pageProps.chapterText:
Yei akyiri no, Hiob buee n’ano na ɔdomee n’awoda. Na Hiob kaa sɛ:
Ma ɛda a wɔwoo me mu no nyera,
ne anadwo a ɛse:
Wɔanyinsɛn ɔbabanin no.
Ɛda no nnuru sum,
mma Onyankopɔn mmfiri soro mmmisa akyiri kwan,
na hann biara nnhyerɛn so.
Esum ne sunsum nnye no,
mununkum ntena so,
deɛ ɛma adekyeeɛ duru sum nyi no hu.
Anadwo no, esum kabii nkuta no,
wɔmmma no nnnya anigyeɛ biara afe nna no mu,
wɔmmma no mmma abosome dodoɔ no mu.
Hwɛ, anadwo no nyɛ kwawee,
ahurisie dwom biara mma mu.
Ma wɔn a wɔdome da no mmɔ no dua,
wɔn a wɔtumi hwanyan dɛnkyɛmmirampɔn mpo no.
N’ahemadakye nsoromma bɛduru sum,
ɛbɛtwɛn hann, na ebi remma,
na ɛrenhunu adekyeeɛ anisuatɛtɛ.
Ɛfiri sɛ anto m’awoɔ apono mu,
na anyi ɔhaw anhunta m’ani.

Adɛn nti na manwu yafunu mu,
na mannyaa mu, awoeɛ?
Adɛn nti na anankoroma sɔɔ me,
na adɛn nti na metoo nufoɔ menumiiɛ?
Anka sɛsɛɛ meda hɔ mayɛ komm,
anka mada, ɛno deɛ anka manya ahomegyeɛ,
me ne ahemfo ne asase so afotufoɔ
a wɔkyekyeree amamfo faeɛ no,
anaasɛ me ne mmapɔmma a wɔwɔ sika,
wɔn a wɔde dwetɛ hyehyɛɛ wɔn afie amaama no.
Anaasɛ menni hɔ sɛ ɛpɔn ba a wɔakora no,
anaa nkɔkoaa a wɔanhunu hann da.
Ɛhɔ na abɔnefoɔ nha obiara bio,
na abrɛfoɔ gye wɔn ahome.
Ɛhɔ ara na nneduafoɔ te dwoodwoo,
wɔnte apiafoɔ nne.
Ɛhɔ na onipa ketewa ne onipa kɛseɛ wɔ,
na akoa afiri ne wura nsa.

Adɛn nti na ɔma mmɔborɔni hann,
na ɔde nkwa ma wɔn a wɔn kra werɛ ahoɔ,
wɔn a wɔtwɛn owuo, na ɛmma,
na wɔbɔre hwehwɛ no sene akoradeɛ,
wɔn a wɔn ani gye mmorosoɔ,
na wɔn ho sɛpɛ wɔn sɛ anka wɔbɛnya damena,
ne ɔbarima a wɔde ne kwan ahunta,
na Onyankopɔn de ban atwa ne ho ahyia?
Na m’apinisie abɛsi m’aduane ananmu,
na mesu gu sɛ nsuo.
Na deɛ mesuro no, ɛno ara na ɛto me,
na deɛ m’akoma tutu ho no, ɛba me so.
Mennya ahodwoɔ ne kommyɛ ne ɔhome,
na ahodwan ara na ɛba.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
